notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
Version 0.1.2 focuses on improving the looks of the environment and combat.

[b]Combat[/b]
- New combat scene focuses on background to enemy/player contrast and perspective 
- Updated combat fierce punch vulnerability so that using the wrong punch when you can get a fierce star now causes the attack to miss instead of the enemy going into a blocking state.
- Updated Florence tutorial combat sprite
- Updated UI positions
- Updated game over scene

[b]Over World[/b]
- Updated various environmental assets for more noise and shifted color palette
- Updated Relis event (again I know, but I think I got it to where I'm happy with it)
- Updated minor dialogue all over

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where Hallow would move out of combat instead of striking a victory pose
- Fixed some UI spelling errors

Again, due to changes in some data, all previous saves and settings will be deleted to account for new data in the system. Thank you for your understanding

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Is Out
notes.content:
The inventory, dialogue, and combat UI has been redesigned.
[list]
[*]Equipment UI now displays Ring, Necklace, and earring to better separate the unique effects for each slot
[*]Config button is streamlined into sub-menus to be more readable
[*]More consistent design textures
[*]Hearts are used to represent the amount of times you can go down now 
[*]Portrait outlines match dialogue boxes
[*]More displays to show what buttons players need to press to access inventory
[/list]

Other updates
[list]
[*]Melty event has new assets
[*]Updated dialogues for better context and grammar
[*]Fixed bug where player's hp increased by 10 when equipping Slot1 with The Storm of the Blood Valley
[*]Added wishlist button to main menu
[/list]

[b]All previous saved games from version 0.1.0 Will be deleted[/b]
To accommodate new data that is not present in previous versions, old saves will be deleted.
Thank you for understanding.
